Who We Are One Partner From First Conversation to Long-Term Support SEC Communications Private Limited was founded in Bengaluru on 5 December 1997. Since then SECCOM has grown into a pan-India systems integrator. Paramilitary forces, defence academies, central power utilities, oil and gas majors, banks, global capability centres, hospital networks, premier educational institutions, manufacturing companies and state agencies all rely on it. SECCOM covers nine solution areas: networking, cybersecurity, data centre, cloud and AI, AV and collaboration, surveillance and security, command centres, smart infrastructure, and IT supply and services. Take one, take several, or ask SECCOM to bring the whole picture together. Either way, the same team designs, supplies, installs, commissions and supports it. Lines That Run, Plants That Scale On the plant floor, availability, quality and worker safety come first. Since 1997, SECCOM has built the networks, security, surveillance and infrastructure behind Indian manufacturing sites. Every phase of the work is planned around your production and shutdown calendar. The line keeps running, safely. Industrial networks have to cope with dust, heat, vibration and three shifts a day. SECCOM specifies industrial connectivity to the conditions of your plant. It designs the failure behaviour explicitly: what happens when a link drops, a controller fails or a path goes quiet. Production stays reliable. New capacity, connected from day one. SECCOM builds the Networking and Smart Infrastructure layer underneath new capacity, scheduled around your shutdown calendar. National programmes are driving that capacity. Production Linked Incentive schemes continue to bring new and expanded plants. SAMARTH Udyog Bharat 4.0 sets the national Industry 4.0 agenda. PM GatiShakti and the National Logistics Policy shape how a plant connects to everything moving in and out of it. See losses before they become scrap. Operations teams want early warning.
